title: Volkswagen started blocking GrapheneOS users
summary: Volkswagen has started blocking users of GrapheneOS, a privacy-focused hardened Android OS, from accessing their official app through SafetyNet/Play Integrity checks that detect custom ROM usage.
problem_solved: Raises awareness about the growing conflict between corporate app policies that restrict privacy-focused OS users and individuals' right to modify their own devices.
why_valuable: Highlights the tension between digital rights, sideloading freedom, and corporate control over software access, sparking important discussions about user autonomy in the mobile ecosystem.
